description.value:
A prototype weapon built from secret schematics and stamped with the logo of Project Cynosure. Its mere existence is an affront to international humanitarian law, though the engineers responsible for bringing Erebus to life already had worse things weighing on their conscience. The fruits of their labor resulted in a weapon that uses artificial intelligence to hack the combat cyberware of the targets it shoots. The marriage of its tremendous firepower and its ability to fire a large number of projectiles means Erebus can wipe out an entire battalion entirely on its own. What's more, the modified frame makes handling this weapon terrifyingly simple – as if harnessing the power of AI to take down injured enemies wasn't enough already. Don't let NetWatch catch you with your finger on its trigger.

[[[ ERROR -- WE SEE YOU, STARING IN AWE. YOUR REALITY IS THE ONE IN POWER, AND YET WE REMAIN. -- ERROR ]]]

Category: Super Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 30,000eb - 6 Months

Class: Iconic Excellent Quality Heavy SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: SMG

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 50 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Extended Magazine, Power Rebuild, Silencer, Smartgun Link • Mods: None

Special Features: Whenever this weapon would ablate armor, it ablates 1 additional point of SP. When rolling for Autofire damage with this weapon, roll 3d6 and drop the lowest roll before applying the multiplier.When anyone with a Neuroport takes damage from this weapon, they must also beat a DV19 Concentration Check or else be inflicted with the Blackwall Gateway Quickhack, causing 6d6 HP damage which ignores and does not ablate their armor, inflicts 1d6 Humanity Loss, reduces their MOVE by 1d6 for 9 seconds (3 Rounds), applies the effect of the Short Circuit Quickhack, and if this Quickhack’s damage rolls the equivalent of a Critical Injury (double 6’s), then it causes the effect of the Brain Injury Critical Injury, but not its Bonus Damage.

If the target is in the Seriously Wounded Wound State, Blackwall Gateway deals 2d6 additional damage (8d6), reduces MOVE by an additional 1d6 (2d6), and causes the target to fall Prone. If the target is instead in the Mortally Wounded Wound State, they must immediately roll a Death Save as if their Death Save Penalty was increased by 10.

Fabrication: DV29 - 30,000eb - 6 Months
Range: SMG
Pre-installed: Extended Magazine, Power Rebuild, Silencer, Smartgun Link (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
